title: Were easier of acceptance by his mind by reason of their august incomprehensibility than was the simple fact that God had loved his soul from all eternity
html_source: Stephen’s experience with his father and family shape his concept of Christianity and God. His father had never given Stephen that explicit love which the Father was purported to give to the Son, so he finds it more difficult to understand that love.
